title: Earth's age measured, and lead pollution exposed
summary: Clair Patterson's 1956 paper gave the age of the solar system as about 4.55 billion years; his work on lead then exposed widespread lead contamination.
why: Fixed the age of the Earth and led to the removal of lead from petrol.

unsung.contribution: Measured Earth's age at 4.55 billion years and campaigned to remove lead from fuel and food cans.
unsung.recognition: Opposed by industry experts, he was refused research contracts and left off a 1971 lead panel despite being the foremost expert.
